questions.title: What is the primary purpose of React Hooks?
answers: To use React state and lifecycle features in function components.

questions.title: You can call React Hooks inside loops or conditions.
What does the useState hook return?
answers: A function to update the state.
An array containing the current state and a function to update it.
An object with the current state and a function to update it.

questions.title: When should you use the useEffect hook?
answers: To perform side effects, like fetching data or subscribing to a service.

questions.title: If you provide an empty dependency array ([]) to useEffect, the effect will run after every render.
What is the purpose of the useMemo hook?
answers: To memoize the result of a function.

questions.title: What does it mean to 'lift state up' in React?
answers: To store state in a global variable.
To move state from a parent component to a child component.
To move shared state to the closest common ancestor of components.

questions.title: The React Context API is a replacement for local component state (useState).
How do you subscribe to a context in a function component?
What is the purpose of the children prop in React?
answers: To pass data from a child component to a parent component.
To pass components or elements as children to other components.
To manage the state of a component.
To handle events in a component.
